integrity: Derivations and exact rational witness given; standalone Python checks supplement an analytic full-domain proof. Numerical checks are not claimed as full-domain certificates.
scientific_limitations: Only positive species-exchange period-two orbits in the deterministic equal-growth, equal-competition map are classified. No classification of nonexchange cycles, global basins, nonhyperbolic boundary dynamics, or stochastic ecological outcomes is claimed. Literature originality can be re-evaluated if an earlier equivalent analytical specialization is located.
title: Sharp antiphase exchange-cycle stability in symmetric two-species Ricker competition
